The '''Quilan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Roche sector/Legends|Roche sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Quilan Pyradex]] artifacts,<ref name="Gamer7">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Quilan Pyradex]]|system=Quilan [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> which were created at some point by [[3638 BBY]].<ref name="TORdate">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}. According to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} lead designer, [[Charles Boyd]], the events of the digital expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] take place in [[3638 BBY]]. Since {{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Solving the Equation}} establishes the existence of [[Quilan Pyradex]]es by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of those events, the artifacts must have been created by that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].</ref> At least one Quilan Pyradex had come to rest on the<ref name="Gamer7" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Gamer7" /> by [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]].<ref name="date">{{GamerCite|7|Secrets of Mos Eisley}} mentions a [[Quilan Pyradex]] being located in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[City/Legends|city]], which was established in [[85 BBY/Legends|85 BBY]], according to ''[[Secrets of Tatooine]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Quilan system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square Q-8.<ref name="TEA" />
